verdict.rationale: Framer's docs confirm automatic version history with one-click restore of any prior version (framer-docs-12, framer-docs-22) and branching to isolate changes (framer-docs-11, framer-docs-47), but there is no evidence of naming/labeling milestones or a side-by-side compare view between versions. Missing for 10: named milestone/checkpoint labeling, version comparison/diff view, independent hands-on confirmation of restore workflow.
